Interrogé sur ce sujet, un assistant du vice-président a déclaré à la BBC que même si Harris ne parle pas régulièrement de la Chine, elle a pour habitude de travailler pour contrer ce qu'ils décrivent comme les efforts de la Chine pour saper la stabilité et la prospérité mondiales.
Mais lorsqu’il s’agit de discuter de la Chine, le contraste entre Trump et Harris pendant la campagne est indéniable.
Lundi après-midi, dans une grange de Smithton, une petite ville rurale de l'ouest de la Pennsylvanie, Trump s'est assis avec un groupe d'agriculteurs et d'éleveurs locaux pour une table ronde consacrée spécifiquement à la Chine.
La ville n’est peut-être qu’à une heure de Pittsburgh, bastion urbain du Parti démocrate, mais c’est un territoire résolument républicain. Des vaches paissaient paisiblement dans des prairies bordées de dizaines de pancartes « Trump pour le président », tandis que des partisans de Trump décoraient deux ânes avec des tenues « Make America Great Again ».
Le thème de l'événement, organisé par Protecting America Initiative, un groupe de réflexion conservateur, était « la menace croissante du Parti communiste chinois pour l'approvisionnement alimentaire des États-Unis ».
Le forum s'est transformé en une discussion plus ouverte sur la menace chinoise, point final. Les agriculteurs, les éleveurs et les chefs d'entreprise présents se sont plaints de devoir faire face à la concurrence d'importations chinoises fortement subventionnées et de la mauvaise qualité des produits chinois.
Bien que l'ancien président n'ait pas passé beaucoup de temps à discuter des dangers perçus de la propriété chinoise des terres agricoles américaines - il a plutôt promis qu'il convaincrait le président chinois Xi Jinping d'acheter davantage d'exportations agricoles américaines - il a de nouveau souligné qu'il utiliserait les tarifs douaniers pour protéger l'économie américaine de la Chine.
À un moment donné, il a évoqué la nécessité de protéger l’industrie sidérurgique américaine – afin de se préparer à une hypothétique guerre avec la Chine.
« Si nous sommes en guerre et que nous avons besoin de chars d'assaut, de navires et d'autres choses en acier, que ferons-nous ? Aller en Chine pour nous procurer de l'acier ? », a-t-il demandé. « Nous combattons la Chine, mais pourriez-vous nous vendre de l'acier ? »
Une partie du travail le plus lourd concernant la Chine au cours du forum a été confiée à Richard Grenell, intervenant à la table ronde et conseiller principal de la Protecting America Initiative.
Il a averti que le pays avait « discrètement mais stratégiquement » travaillé contre les États-Unis – en particulier lorsque les Américains étaient distraits par d’autres problèmes mondiaux.
« Ils s’en prennent à nos élus locaux et régionaux, à notre secteur manufacturier », a-t-il déclaré. « Il ne fait aucun doute qu’ils cherchent, à un moment donné, à tirer parti de cet investissement et de cette activité. »
Grenell, qui a été ambassadeur des États-Unis en Allemagne et directeur par intérim du renseignement national pendant que Trump était au pouvoir, est considéré comme un possible secrétaire d'État - le plus haut diplomate américain - si Trump remporte un autre mandat en novembre.
En revanche, si Harris gagne, il n’y aura peut-être pas de changement significatif par rapport à l’administration Biden actuelle, même si le président actuel a souvent déployé une rhétorique plus acerbe pour décrire la rivalité entre les États-Unis et la Chine.
Depuis le début de sa présidence, Joe Biden a identifié la Chine comme l'une des autocraties en concurrence avec les principales démocraties du monde dans ce qu'il décrit comme un point d'inflexion mondial historique.
D'après les sondages d'opinion, la Chine n'occupe qu'une place mineure dans la liste des questions qui préoccupent les électeurs américains, devancée par l'économie, l'immigration et les soins de santé.
Dans un récent sondage réalisé par la National Security Action auprès d'électeurs des États clés de la bataille électorale, seuls 14 % ont cité la Chine comme la principale priorité du prochain président en matière de sécurité nationale. L'immigration arrive en tête de liste avec 38 %, suivie par les guerres en Ukraine et à Gaza, toutes deux avec 28 %.
Cela pourrait expliquer en partie le manque d'intérêt apparent de M. Harris pour la Chine.
Dans cette campagne présidentielle abrégée, elle dispose d'un délai plus court pour se définir aux yeux des électeurs, de sorte que se concentrer sur le principal concurrent économique des États-Unis pourrait être moins prioritaire pour la démocrate.
Après l'événement organisé par M. Trump à Smithton, Bill Bretz, président du comité local du Parti républicain du comté, a déclaré que même si la Chine n'était pas au premier rang des préoccupations des électeurs de Pennsylvanie, il était important que M. Trump en parle.
En tant que plus grand enjeu électoral, la Pennsylvanie est peut-être l'État pivot de l'élection présidentielle de 2024. Trump et Harris auront du mal à gagner la Maison Blanche sans cet État dans leur colonne. Les sondages montrent actuellement que les deux candidats sont à égalité dans cet État.
« La majorité des gens ont déjà choisi leur camp, mais il y a des indécis », a-t-il déclaré. « Si la Chine est une paille qui fait pencher la balance d'un côté ou de l'autre, je pense que c'est une bonne chose à mettre sur le tapis.
Reportage complémentaire de Jake Horton et BBC Verify

title: Wakefield Long Division music festival to end after 12 years
text:
A music festival which has brought big names and emerging artists to a city in West Yorkshire for more than a decade is to end.
Since 2011, Wakefield's annual Long Division festival has seen bands and artists play at venues in the city and often attracts up to 4,000 gig-goers.
But organisers of the event have said it was "not financially viable" in the long term due to many factors.
They said they would "sign off in style" with a last festival on 10 June.
Artists Billy Bragg, The Cribs, Asian Dub Foundation and The Fall have been among the 1,000 performers to have graced Long Division's stages since it started.
An education programme has run alongside the festival, aiming to inspire young people in the district to get involved in live music.
The festival, which is run by a not-for-profit company, saw a slump in finances during 2020 due to the impact of the Covid pandemic on the arts, but was kept afloat by a community crowdfunding drive.
Dean Freeman, Long Division founder and director, said the final festival would be "the culmination of 12 years of madness in Wakefield".
"Long term, it's just not financially viable for lots of reasons," he said.
"We didn't want to compromise or dilute what we do and we also felt passionately that getting to write your own ending is perhaps something many festivals, shops, labels and bands don't get to do."
The festival would "end on a massive high", Mr Freeman added.

text:
Coronavirus: China informa de un aumento pronunciado de casos y muertes por la enfermedad
  - Autor, Redacción
  - Título del autor, BBC News Mundo
- Fecha de publicación
- Tiempo de lectura: 4 min
El miércoles se registraron 242 muertes por el coronavirus en la provincia de Hubei, China, el día más mortal desde el inicio del brote.
También hubo un pronunciado aumento en el número de casos, con 14.840 personas siendo diagnosticadas con el virus, informaron autoridades chinas.
Hubei ha estado aplicando una definición más amplia para diagnosticar pacientes, lo que explica el aumento en la mayoría de los casos.
China destituyó a dos altos funcionarios de la provincia de Hubei horas después de que se revelaran las nuevas cifras.
Hasta ese incremento del miércoles, el número de personas diagnosticadas en Hubei -donde surgió el brote- venía estabilizándose.
Pero los nuevos casos y muertes en la provincia han elevado la cifra de muertos a nivel nacional por encima de los 1.350, con casi 60.000 infecciones en total.
"Lo que ha sucedido en China es que han cambiado la definición de lo que es la enfermedad. Ahora están registrando personas que tienen síntomas menores", comentó David Heymann, profesor de Epidemiología de Enfermedades Infecciosas de la Escuela de Higiene y Medicina Tropical de Londres.
"Las muertes son muy preocupantes, hay un incremento en el número de muertes reportadas, pero si se toma el número total de muertes y el número total de casos, el índice de mortandad es más o menos el mismo, aunque sigue siendo alto, tan alto como el índice de mortandad de la influenza".
Entretanto, el secretario de Partido Comunista en Hubei, Jiang Chaoliang, fue sustituido por el jefe del partido de Shanghái, Ying Yong, según medios estatales. El jefe del partido en la ciudad capital de Wuhan, también fue destituido.
Es el cambio más grande de funcionarios del partido en Hubei desde el inicio del brote. Con anterioridad, varios funcionarios fueron "retirados" de sus cargos.
¿Cómo es el nuevo método de diagnóstico?
La provincia -que cuenta con más de 80% de todas la infecciones en China- ahora incluye "casos clínicamente diagnosticados" dentro del número de casos confirmados.
Eso significa que se incluyen los que manifiestan síntomas y los que registran pulmones infectados tras escaneo CT, en lugar de simplemente confiar en las pruebas estándar de ácido nucléico.
De las 242 nuevas muertes en Wuhan, 135 son consistentes con esos casos "clínicamente diagnosticados".
O sea que, aun sin la nueva definición, en número de muertes en Hubei, el miércoles, fue de 107, un nuevo récord para la provincia.
De las nuevas 14.840 infecciones en esa región, 13.332 fueron casos clínicamente diagnosticados.
En total, la provincia tiene 48.206 casos confirmados.
¿Qué dice la OMS?
La Organización Mundial de la Salud, OMS, dijo que era "demasiado temprano" para predecir el fin de la epidemia. "Este brote todavía puede ir en cualquier dirección", advirtió el director general.
La OMS ha podido rastrear la fuente de transmisión de todos -salvo ocho- de los 441 casos de virus fuera de China, según el jefe de emergencias Michael Ryan.
"Creo que se demasiado temprano para predecir el inicio, el medio y el fin de esta epidemia en estos momentos", añadió el funcionario.
El martes, el alto epidemiólogo de China, Zhong Nanshan, dijo que la epidemia debería alcanzar su tope en China este mes, antes de mermar.
Hay cuatro posibles vacunas que están siendo financiadas para desarrollo pre clínico, informó a la prensa la directora de ciencia de la OMS, Soumya Swaminathan.
"Creo que encontraremos una vacuna", dijo. "Tomará algún tempo. Una vacuna no se puede hacer de la noche a la mañana".

- Se espera que el eventos deportivo más importantes de Hong Kong, Rugby Sevens, sea cancelado. Igualmente el torneo de rugby de Singapur.
- El Grand Prix de Formula 1 de China, programado en Shanghái para el 19 de abril, se pospuso.

title: Donald Trump : De l'immobilier à la politique
text:
Le milliardaire qui veut revenir à la Maison Blanche
Bien avant de présenter trois candidatures consécutives à la présidence des États-Unis, Donald Trump était le milliardaire le plus flamboyant d'Amérique.
La vie du magnat de l'immobilier new-yorkais a été étalée dans les tabloïds et à la télévision au cours des décennies qui ont précédé son improbable course à la Maison-Blanche en 2015-2016.
Sa notoriété et son style de campagne sans filtre l'ont aidé à vaincre des politiciens chevronnés, mais il a été chassé du pouvoir après un seul mandat en raison d'une multitude de controverses.
Aujourd'hui âgé de 78 ans, le républicain défie à nouveau les pronostics en effectuant un comeback politique qui pourrait se solder par son retour derrière le bureau du président dans le bureau ovale.
L'héritier
Trump est le quatrième enfant du magnat de l'immobilier new-yorkais Fred Trump.
Malgré la richesse de la famille, il était censé occuper les emplois les plus modestes au sein de l'entreprise de son père et a été envoyé dans une académie militaire à l'âge de 13 ans lorsqu'il a commencé à mal se comporter à l'école.
Après avoir obtenu un diplôme de la Wharton School de l'université de Pennsylvanie, il a été favorisé pour succéder à son père lorsque son frère aîné, Fred, a choisi de devenir pilote.
Fred Trump est mort à 43 ans des suites de l'alcoolisme, ce qui, selon son frère, l'a conduit à éviter l'alcool et la cigarette toute sa vie.
M. Trump affirme qu'il est entré dans l'immobilier grâce à un « petit » prêt d'un million de dollars accordé par son père avant de rejoindre l'entreprise.
Il a participé à la gestion du vaste portefeuille de projets résidentiels de son père dans les arrondissements de New York et a pris le contrôle de l'entreprise - qu'il a rebaptisée « Trump Organization » - en 1971.
Son père, que M. Trump décrit comme « mon inspiration », est décédé en 1999.
La marque
Sous le règne de Trump, l'entreprise familiale est passée des unités résidentielles de Brooklyn et du Queens à des projets prestigieux à Manhattan.
La célèbre Cinquième Avenue a accueilli la Trump Tower, sans doute la propriété la plus célèbre du magnat et sa résidence pendant de nombreuses années. L'hôtel Commodore, délabré, a été restauré pour devenir le Grand Hyatt.
D'autres propriétés portant la marque Trump - casinos, condominiums, terrains de golf et hôtels - ont également été construites à Atlantic City, Chicago et Las Vegas, ainsi qu'en Inde, en Turquie et aux Philippines.
Son ascension vers la célébrité s'est poursuivie dans le monde du spectacle, d'abord en tant que propriétaire des concours de beauté Miss Univers, Miss USA et Miss Teen USA, puis en tant que créateur et animateur de l'émission de téléréalité The Apprentice, diffusée sur NBC.
Pendant 14 saisons, les candidats de The Apprentice se sont affrontés pour décrocher un contrat de gestion dans son empire commercial, et sa célèbre réplique « Vous êtes viré ! » a fait de « The Donald » un nom connu de tous.
Donald Trump a écrit plusieurs livres, est apparu dans des films et des émissions de catch professionnel, et a vendu de tout, des boissons aux cravates. Mais sa valeur nette a chuté ces dernières années, Forbes estimant qu'il vaut actuellement environ 4 milliards de dollars.
M. Trump a également fait faillite à six reprises et plusieurs de ses entreprises, dont Trump Steaks et l'université Trump, se sont effondrées.
Il a également protégé ses informations fiscales de tout examen minutieux, et le New York Times a révélé en 2020 des années d'évitement de l'impôt sur le revenu et de pertes financières chroniques.
La famille
La vie privée de Donald Trump a fait l'objet d'une grande publicité.
Sa première femme, et sans doute la plus célèbre, était Ivana Zelnickova, une athlète et mannequin tchèque. Le couple a eu trois enfants - Donald Jr, Ivanka et Eric - avant de divorcer en 1990.
Leur bataille judiciaire acrimonieuse a fait la une des journaux à potins, et les allégations de violence domestique de la défunte Mme Trump - qu'elle a par la suite minimisées - figurent dans un nouveau film sur M. Trump.
Il a épousé l'actrice Marla Maples en 1993, deux mois après la naissance de leur unique enfant, Tiffany. Ils ont divorcé en 1999.
L'épouse actuelle de Trump est l'ancien mannequin slovène Melania Knauss. Ils se sont mariés en 2005 et ont un fils, Barron William Trump, qui a récemment fêté ses 18 ans.
Des allégations d'inconduite sexuelle et de liaisons extraconjugales ont suivi l'homme politique Trump.
Au début de l'année, deux jurys distincts ont jugé que M. Trump avait diffamé l'écrivain E. Jean Carroll en niant ses accusations d'agression sexuelle. Il a été condamné à lui verser 88 millions de dollars au total, mais a fait appel.
M. Trump a également été reconnu coupable de 34 chefs d'accusation pour avoir falsifié des documents commerciaux afin de dissimuler un accord de silence avec l'actrice de films pour adultes Stormy Daniels au sujet d'une prétendue relation extraconjugale en 2006.
Le candidat
Dans une interview datant de 1980, Trump, alors âgé de 34 ans, décrit la politique comme « un milieu très méchant » et affirme que « les personnes les plus capables » choisissent plutôt le monde des affaires.
Dès 1987, il commence à évoquer une candidature à l'élection présidentielle. Il a brièvement envisagé de se lancer dans la course en 2000 avec le Parti de la réforme, puis à nouveau en 2012 en tant que républicain.
Trump a été l'un des plus fervents partisans du « birtherisme », la théorie du complot qui remet en question le fait que Barack Obama soit né aux États-Unis. Il n'a admis qu'il s'agissait d'un mensonge qu'en 2016 et ne s'est jamais excusé.
Ce n'est qu'en juin 2015 que M. Trump a officiellement annoncé sa candidature à la Maison Blanche, déclarant que le rêve américain était mort mais promettant de le « ramener plus grand et meilleur ».
Dans son discours en roue libre, il a fait étalage de sa richesse et de sa réussite en affaires, a accusé le Mexique d'envoyer de la drogue, des criminels et des violeurs aux États-Unis et a promis de faire payer au pays un mur à la frontière.
Ses démonstrations dominantes sur la scène du débat et sa plateforme politique controversée ont attiré aussi bien des fans et des critiques féroces , ainsi qu'un torrent d'attention de la part des médias.
Sous le slogan « Make America Great Again », il a facilement dépassé ses rivaux du parti républicain pour affronter la démocrate Hillary Clinton.
La campagne du candidat novice a été entachée de controverses, notamment une fuite d'un enregistrement audio le montrant en train de se vanter d'abus sexuels, et il s'est retrouvé à la traîne dans les sondages d'opinion pendant toute la durée de l'élection générale.
Mais M. Trump a eu le dernier mot face aux experts et aux sondeurs en remportant une victoire éclatante sur un politicien chevronné. Il a prêté serment en tant que 45e président du pays le 20 janvier 2017.
Le président
Dès les premières heures, il a apporté une dimension dramatique inégalée à son poste, faisant souvent des annonces officielles sur Twitter (aujourd'hui X) et s'opposant ouvertement aux dirigeants étrangers.

Il s'est retiré des principaux accords climatiques et commerciaux, a interdit les voyages en provenance de sept pays à majorité musulmane, a émis d'autres restrictions sévères en matière d'immigration, a lancé une guerre commerciale avec la Chine, a mis en œuvre des réductions d'impôts record et a remodelé les relations avec le Moyen-Orient.
Pendant près de deux ans, un avocat spécial a enquêté sur la collusion présumée entre la campagne Trump de 2016 et la Russie. Trente-quatre personnes ont été inculpées pour des faits tels que le piratage informatique et des délits financiers, mais pas M. Trump. L'enquête n'a pas permis d'établir une collusion criminelle.
Peu après, M. Trump est devenu le troisième président américain de l'histoire à être destitué, car il est accusé d'avoir fait pression sur un gouvernement étranger pour obtenir des informations compromettantes sur son rival démocrate Joe Biden. Il a été destitué par une Chambre des représentants dirigée par les démocrates, mais acquitté par un Sénat dirigé par les républicains.
L'année électorale 2020 a été dominée par la pandémie de coronavirus.
Il a fait l'objet de vives critiques pour sa gestion de la crise, alors que les États-Unis étaient en tête du classement mondial des décès et des infections, et pour des commentaires controversés, comme la suggestion de mener des recherches sur la possibilité de traiter le virus par l'injection d'un désinfectant dans le corps.
En octobre, il a été contraint d'interrompre sa campagne électorale après qu'on lui a diagnostiqué une infection par le virus Covid-19.
Bien qu'il ait finalement obtenu 74 millions de voix - plus que tout autre président américain en exercice - il a perdu la course face à M. Biden avec plus de sept millions de voix d'avance.
De novembre 2020 à janvier 2021, il a multiplié les allégations de votes volés et de fraude électorale généralisée, allégations qui ont été rejetées dans plus de 60 affaires judiciaires.
Refusant d'accepter les résultats, M. Trump a rassemblé ses partisans à Washington le 6 janvier, les exhortant à converger vers le Capitole alors que la victoire de M. Biden allait être officiellement certifiée par le Congrès.
Ce rassemblement a dégénéré en émeute qui a mis en danger les législateurs et son propre vice-président et a conduit à une deuxième destitution historique. Trump a de nouveau été acquitté par le Sénat, mais de justesse.
Les actes qu'il a commis ce jour-là font désormais l'objet de deux affaires pénales.
Le retour
Après l'assaut du Capitole, la carrière politique de M. Trump semblait pratiquement morte. Les donateurs et les partisans ont juré de ne plus jamais le soutenir, et même ses plus proches alliés l'ont publiquement désavoué.
Il n'a pas assisté à l'investiture de son successeur et a déménagé sa famille en Floride, mais, fort d'une armée de supporters fidèles, il a conservé une influence considérable sur le parti républicain.
L'héritage le plus durable de sa présidence est peut-être venu après la fin de celle-ci, lorsque les trois juges de droite qu'il avait nommés à la Cour suprême ont cimenté une majorité conservatrice qui a contribué à mettre fin à près de 50 ans de droit à l'avortement au niveau national.
Bien qu'il ait été blâmé pour les mauvais résultats obtenus par les républicains lors des élections de mi-mandat de 2022, M. Trump a annoncé une nouvelle candidature à la présidence et est rapidement devenu le favori de son parti.
Plus d'une douzaine d'adversaires, dont son ancien vice-président, l'ont défié mais n'ont pas réussi à s'imposer, M. Trump évitant le débat au sein du parti et concentrant ses tirs sur M. Biden.
Au début de l'élection générale, Donald Trump devait répondre de 91 chefs d'accusation dans quatre affaires pénales, mais sa stratégie consistant à retarder les procédures judiciaires a largement porté ses fruits. Trois affaires n'auront plus lieu avant l'élection, et sa condamnation à New York - pour l'ensemble d'accusations sans doute le plus faible - a été reportée à la fin du mois de novembre.
Le 13 juillet, un jeune homme de 20 ans a tenté d'assassiner Donald Trump lors d'un meeting de campagne à Butler, en Pennsylvanie. Thomas Matthew Crooks a tiré huit balles d'un fusil de type AR depuis un toit voisin, blessant Trump à l'oreille droite avant que le tireur ne soit tué par des contre-tireurs.
Quelques jours plus tard, lors de la convention nationale républicaine, le parti l'a couvert d'éloges et l'a officiellement couronné candidat républicain à la présidence pour la troisième fois consécutive, préparant ainsi un match retour avec M. Biden.
Le mandat du président démocrate, historiquement impopulaire, a été marqué par des progrès en matière d'économie et d'infrastructures après la pandémie, mais aussi par une inflation élevée, une augmentation de l'immigration clandestine et une politique étrangère chaotique.
Depuis que M. Biden s'est retiré et a soutenu la vice-présidente, Kamala Harris, M. Trump a cherché à l'associer aux échecs de l'administration, avec un succès mitigé.
Les sondages nationaux indiquent que, bien que Mme Harris ait galvanisé les électeurs libéraux et recueilli des millions de dollars, l'issue du scrutin reste indécise.
Il a déclaré à ses partisans que le 5 novembre 2024, date de l'élection américaine, serait « la date la plus importante de l'histoire de notre pays ».

title: Fiat warns of coronavirus risk to Europe car plant
text:
Fiat Chrysler says the impact of the coronavirus epidemic could halt production at one of its European car plants within four weeks.
Car firms are on alert over possible disruption to Chinese factories and suppliers, but Fiat's warning is the first to highlight an impact in Europe.
Fiat said supply chain issues could stop factory production in two-to-four weeks but he did not name the facility.
The virus emerged in Wuhan, home to many major car firms and suppliers.
Nissan, General Motors, Honda, Renault and Peugeot-owner PSA are among the companies with major facilities in Hubei province and Wuhan city, which has been in lockdown since January.
However, motor industry operations outside the region could also be disrupted as measures to control the epidemic are enforced.
Germany's Volkswagen is thought to have about 40 plants in China making cars and components.
'Critical'
Fiat's chief executive, Mike Manley, told the Financial Times , externalthere was one "critical" supplier of parts that was putting European production at risk.
He said he was also concerned about the possible impact of three other suppliers in China.
Chinese car parts and assembly plants have extended previously planned Lunar New Year's shutdowns until about 9 February, and some have pushed the shutdowns out further.
Fiat Chrysler operates in China through a loss-making joint venture with Guangzhou Automobile Group and has a 0.35% share of the Chinese passenger car market.
Japan's Toyota, which has a big UK plant, said it is monitoring the situation but there was currently no impact on any operations in Europe.
A spokesman said: "As of January 24, we have restricted travel to Hubei province, including Wuhan city. As of January 31, we have also restricted unnecessary travel to other areas in China.
"Since there is an extensive supply chain in the automotive industry and there are a wide range of parts and components that are used for vehicles, it is difficult to specifically comment."
South Korea's Hyundai, the world's fifth-largest automaker, has temporarily stopped production lines at its factories in the country because of shortages of Chinese parts.
And Volvo has been forced to switch battery suppliers to keep production lines operating.

title: Лайк за прививку, бан за отрицание. Как азербайджанские врачи в "Фейсбуке" помогают жителям в пандемию
text:
Лайк за прививку, в бан за отрицание. Как азербайджанские врачи скоординировались в "Фейсбуке" и помогают жителям пережить пандемию
  - Автор, Магеррам Зейналов
  - Место работы, Би-би-си, Баку
- Опубликовано
В Азербайджане уже несколько лет очень популярны группы в "Фейсбуке", где можно получить у врача бесплатную консультацию по несложному вопросу, найти по рекомендации доктора или медсестру. С началом пандемии эти группы почти полностью переключились на ковид: они сразу рекомендовали носить маски, держать дистанцию, а позже и делать прививки. Заодно все это время они вели просветительскую работу, а противников вакцинации или переубеждали или - когда заканчивались аргументы - банили.
Скорая онлайн-помощь
Когда "Фейсбук" только набирал в Азербайджане популярность, врач-дерматолог Орхан Абдуллаев увидел, как люди начали раздавать в соцсети медицинские советы. "Там было так: "моя соседка принимала аспирин от головной боли, и ты тоже принимай", - рассказывает врач. - А у человека, может быть, язва желудка, и тогда аспирин принимать нельзя".
Тогда, десять лет назад, молодой врач с трехлетним стажем решил, что так нельзя. Абдуллаев собрал своих приятелей и однокурсников и предложил создать в "Фейсбуке" группу "Онлайн медицинская консультация" (ОМК).
"Я просто собрал врачей, которые начали давать нормальные советы; мы тогда не думали о саморекламе, мы были просто энтузиастами, - вспоминает он. - Кто-то из докторов работал на море (так в Баку говорят о врачах, работающих в нефтяных компаниях и уходящих в морские вахты на Каспии), другие - в скорой помощи, а там ты клиентуры не соберешь. Мы просто давали правильные бесплатные советы, каждый по своей специальности".
Абдуллаев сразу говорит, что речь идет о тех случаях, когда можно разобраться с проблемой онлайн, в других же ситуациях необходимо записываться на прием, сдавать анализы и получать полноценную помощь. В его случае (Орхан Абдуллаев - дерматолог) проблему обычно можно решить, отправив врачу фото участка кожи личным сообщением.
В итоге уже через несколько лет в Баку стало нормой при недомогании заходить в одну из медицинских групп в "Фейсбуке" в поисках профильного специалиста, почитать на него отзывы. И потом попросить у него консультацию или записаться на прием. Причем в этих группах есть люди и из других стран.
Медпросвет
Терапевт Заур Оруджев начинал в той же группе ОМК. Он говорит, что сам не ожидал, что медицинские группы будут пользоваться такой большой популярностью. "Начав группу, мы даже не то, чтобы закрыли спрос или заняли пустую нишу. Это было, как воздух, заполнивший вакуум", - рассказывает он.
С одной стороны, группа позволила молодым врачам заявить о себе и найти клиентов. Но главное для них то, что она дала им возможность заниматься просвещением.
Заур Оруджев позже отошел от ОМК и создал с коллегами другую группу - "МедПросвет". В ней врачи тоже общаются с пациентами, но еще убеждают в необходимости прививки, борются против гомеопатии и народной медицины, граничащей с магией.
Он вспоминает, что в его институте редко говорили о доказательной медицине, базирующейся на современных исследованиях и стандартных протоколах лечения. "Хотя я знал хороших старых врачей, потрясающих врачей, которые говорили о ней, но в интернете про них не слышали, - рассказывает он, - А молодые смогли лучше разобраться в соцсетях и говорить об этом уже там".
Ковид и гражданское общество
Пандемия коронавируса стала самым тяжелым временем в истории двух этих медицинских групп в "Фейсбуке", говорит Заур Оруджев.
На врачей, как и во всем мире, свалилось огромное количество работы. И часто членам группы приходилось искать специалистов или клиники, где есть свободные места для больных ковидом. На пике пандемии бывали случаи, когда в медицинские группы обращались люди, которые не могли положить в больницу тяжелого коронавирусного больного. Оруджев писал, что трое членов группы "МедПросвет" умерли, не дождавшись госпитализации.
В июне 2020 года в Баку и других городах Азербайджана ввели полный запрет на выход из дома, закрылись магазины и аптеки. Даже мусор вынести было нельзя. Выходить можно было, только чтобы попасть в больницы и на похороны. Эти действия привели к протестам и полицейскому насилию. Тех, кто бросал мусор с балконов в полицейскую машину, силовики выволакивали из дома - иногда даже голыми, - и снимали это на видео.
Тогда "МедПросвет" организовал коллективное письмо на имя президента, вице-президента и уполномоченного по правам человека. Подписанты назвали ограничения необдуманными и попросили провести их ревизию. "Не были учтены интересы больных другими болезнями, семей, где есть дети с РАС (расстройством аутистического спектра) и других, - говорит Заур. - Как три дня такого ребенка держать дома?"
По его словам, такие радикальные меры необходимо было изначально обсудить с представителями гражданского общества.
Как говорит Заур Оруджев, с ним встретилась уполномоченная по правам человека в Азербайджане Сабина Алиева и помощник президента Анар Алекперов.
"Самое главное, что нам дали канал связи, и после этого мы наладили общение с TEBIB (Объединение по управлению медицинскими территориальными подразделениями Азербайджана) и отделом по связью с общественностью минздрава. Когда тяжелые пациенты не могли найти место в больнице, на пиках коронавируса мы смогли [с помощью чиновников] напрямую разрешать самые тяжелые ситуации", - рассказывает Оруджев.
Официальные органы власти, правда, не хотят это подтверждать. В TEBIB Русской службе Би-би-си заявили, что не слышали о медицинских группах в "Фейсбуке". В минздраве Азербайджана добавили, что не сотрудничают с какими либо "неофициальными" медицинскими группами. Там своими силами распространяют медицинскую информацию, в том числе в соцсетях.
Разговоры о вакцинах
Заур Оруджев подчеркивает, что главная задача "МедПросвета" - не лечение людей онлайн, а просвещение.
"У нас могут дать дорожную карту: что это за заболевание может быть, что надо проверить, и к кому следует пойти", - говорит Заур Оруджев. В "МедПросвете" запрещено ставить психиатрические диагнозы, обсуждать необходимость аборта и выписывать лекарства.
"Врач врачу рознь, - говорит Орхан Абдуллаев из ОМК. - Понятно, что гинеколог онлайн ничего не посоветует, а дерматолог в большинстве случаев может. Нашей задачей было сделать так, чтобы когда у человека нет денег или времени на обращение к специалисту по простому вопросу, он бы не лез за советом к некомпетентным и посторонним людям".
Обычно в группах можно было встретить посты с вопросам о беременности, болезнях детей, но с началом пандемии коронавирус занял существенную часть онлайн-общения. Люди ищут врачей и медсестер, спрашивают советы по прививкам.
Женщина просит порекомендовать ей медсестру в центре города, чтобы поставить на дому систему ее близкому с ковидом. Ей в ответ рекомендуют сразу нескольких.
Несколько человек, переболевших Covid-19, рассказывают о своих симптомах, обсуждают потерю обоняния и другие последствия коронавируса. У пожилого человека после тяжело перенесенного ковида не восстановился уровень сахара - ему советуют профильных врачей. Много записей с благодарностями врачам за помощь.
Женщина по имени Фатима начинает свой пост с предупреждения: "Я не антипрививочник", а потом спрашивает, есть ли способы защититься от тяжелой реакции на конкретную вакцину - она слышала, что от нее человека якобы может парализовать. Администратор группы отметил в комментариях профильного врача, тот вскоре пришел и рассказал, что случаев паралича ни от одной вакцины в мире зафиксировано не было, и предупредил, что от коронавируса проблемы будут еще серьезнее.
Очень много в группах разговоров о том, какую вакцину кто выбирает для вакцинации и ревакцинации, какие последствия были после прививок. В Азербайджане доступны российский "Спутник-V", китайский Sinovac, западные Pfizer и AstraZeneca. Позиция врачей в обеих группах - выбор вакцины не важен, главное - сделать прививку.
Просвещать и убеждать
Когда началась пандемия, просветительская работа в группах сосредоточилась только на ней.
Врачи, никак не синхронизируясь с призывами властей, сразу заговорили о том, что нужно носить маски и соблюдать социальную дистанцию. Когда в январе 2021 года в Азербайджан поставили первую вакцину - Sinovac, сразу начались призывы вакцинироваться.
В "МедПросвете", помимо этого, стали регулярно публиковать рекомендации ВОЗ и их обновления. А кроме этого, переводили основные работы и рекомендации иностранных исследовательских центров, включая американский CDC (Центр по контролю и профилактике заболеваний США). "Когда со временем данные стали меняться, мы стали их обновлять - и из-за этого нам прилетало от комментаторов, - рассказывает Заур Оруджев. - Дело в том, что собирается новая статистика, данные корректируются, это нормально, именно так наука и работает, но это не все понимают".
Он рассказывает, как во время пандемии врачей из "МедПросвета" стали звать на интервью, где те рассказывали о коронавирусе и прививках. Участник группы - кардиолог Заур Исламов - попал на местный телеканал CBC, где призывал людей с сердечно-сосудистыми заболеваниями пройти вакцинацию, а не бояться ее, потому что они - в группе риска.
Под этим и другими видео в группе "МедПросвет" много комментариев от людей, которые не доверяют прививкам.
Заур Оруджев говорит, что в какой-то момент понял, что надо попробовать достучаться до них: "Это работало, были кейсы, когда нам удавалось убедить прививаться сомневающихся, с упертыми сделать что-то уже сложно".
Давать ли слово антипрививочникам?
Заур Оруджев рассказывает, что правило, запрещающее посты отрицателей ковида и антипрививочников, они ввели еще в самом начале пандемии.
"Врачей-антипрививочников баним еще более сурово, чем простых людей, потому что есть научный консенсус на тему прививок, и они должны были об этом знать, - говорит Оруджев. - Была у нас настойчивая педиатр, которая отправилась в бан сразу, потому что детский врач-антиваксер - это ужасно".
Во второй большой группе, ОМК, подход к противникам вакцинации тот же. "С антипрививочниками и гомеопатами мы и раньше постоянно сражались, - говорит Орхан Абдуллаев. - А сейчас я не спорю: если человеку 40 лет и он не понимает, как работает наука, его надо заблокировать, чтобы он не отравлял [своим незнанием] окружающих".
Еще до пандемии Абдуллаев пробовал устраивать публичные дебаты с антипрививочниками и сторонниками гомеопатии, но ничего из этого не вышло: "Истина в таких случаях остается где-то в стороне. Надо понять, что у них не логика, а другой тип мышления - гомеопатия граничит с теорией лунного заговора [о том, что американцы не высаживались на Луне]. И когда приводишь им статистику, протокольные данные - им это ничего не доказывает".
Правила, установленные в группе "МедПросвет", пользователи называли даже "тоталитарными" - разговоров с противниками вакцинации тут не ведут. "Те, кто поддерживает [отказы вакцинироваться], вот эти все блогеры, которым смешно и весело, кто с хитрым прищуром в стиле "ну уж мы-то знаем" иронизирует по поводу обязательной вакцинации, вот они просто убийцы. Вот с этим и надо бороться", - настаивает Заур Оруджев.
Он считает, что с доказательной медициной тоже можно спорить, но обладая профильными знаниями. "Это как в институте послушать профессора, а потом на перемене с ним не согласиться", - говорит он. Такая свобода мнений, по его словам, все равно помогает людям чаще узнавать и распространять научные тренды.
Орхан Абдуллаев из ОМК в целом более скептичен: "Просвещение - это бездонная бочка. Ты пытаешься переубедить людей, у тебя не получается, и потом ты просыпаешься - тебе 33 года, а ведь ничего не изменилось".
Рисунки Магеррама Зейналова

title: Stereophonics phone box in Cwmaman has 'likely been scrapped', says BT
text:
Village's Stereophonics phone box has 'likely been scrapped'
A south Wales phone box made famous by rock group Stereophonics has "likely been scrapped", telecoms firm BT has revealed.
The red kiosk in the band's home village of Cwmaman, Rhondda Cynon Taf (RCT), had become a favourite destination for visiting fans after providing the site for a celebrated photoshoot in 1997.
It was removed by BT in 2019, angering locals who lobbied to have it put back. BT now says "those conversations were not followed up during the pandemic", resulting in the box spending years in storage where it can no longer be located.
Vikki Howells, MS for Cynon Valley, had previously called it "an important cultural landmark" and admitted to being "very disappointed" at the news.
The kiosk was where, nearly 29 years ago, the group's original line-up of Kelly Jones, Richard Jones and Stuart Cable posed for veteran photographer Martyn Goodacre, whose portfolio includes the legendary likes of The Rolling Stones and Nirvana.
The group had just released their debut album Word Gets Around and were on the cusp of winning Best British Breakthrough Act at the 1998 Brit Awards.
Having had various upgrades during its lifetime - including new glass, paintwork and signage - the payphone was one of several to have been earmarked for removal across RCT in 2019.
According to BT's records, it had only been used 13 times in the 12 months prior to being taken away.
However, the likes of Howells fought at the time to get it back.
"I worked really hard to get it returned to Cwmaman, but I needed to find people willing to take responsibility for its upkeep once it got back there," she said.
"Unfortunately, Covid came along not long afterwards and its impact was so great on so many lives.
"As a result, most folk understandably had little time to think of anything else."
Shaun Griffiths, who runs The Shepherds Arms pub on Fforchaman Road, where the phone box had stood for decades, said it was a "real shame to hear what's happened".
"Fans would come from all over the place to have their photos taken there, which was always a good thing for a little village like this.
"There was even talk of transforming it into a mini music booth in which you could hear 'Phonics tunes playing - even turning it into a book exchange or heart defibrillator station would have been good."
A BT spokesperson said requests to adopt the kiosk in 2019 "had not followed the usual process, the payphone having already been removed following a formal consultation".
"Conversations about adoption were then not followed up during the pandemic.
"We can confirm that the payphone is no longer being stored by our contractor, and, while our records do not go back that far, it is likely to have been scrapped," they added.

title: China issues travel warning as virus deaths surge
text:
Chinese authorities have urged people to stop travelling in and out of Wuhan, the city at the centre of a new virus outbreak that has killed 17 people.
Those living in the city of 8.9 million people have also been told to avoid crowds and minimise public gatherings.
The new virus has spread from Wuhan to several Chinese provinces, as well as the US, Thailand and South Korea.
There are 440 confirmed cases, with the origin a seafood market that "conducted illegal transactions of wild animals".
Late on Wednesday the Chinese authorities confirmed the number of dead had almost doubled - from nine - in the space of a day. All fatalities so far have been in Hubei, the province around Wuhan.
Officials in Hong Kong also reported the territory's first two cases, external.
Meanwhile, in Geneva, the World Health Organization's emergency committee is meeting to assess the global risks posed by the virus and decide if it should be declared an international public health emergency - as happened with swine flu and Ebola.
Such a declaration, if made, could see advice issued on travel or trade restrictions.
Chinese authorities admitted the country was now at the "most critical stage" of prevention and control.
"Basically, do not go to Wuhan. And those in Wuhan please do not leave the city," said National Health Commission vice-minister Li Bin in one of the first public briefings since the beginning of the outbreak.
Earlier this week, China confirmed that human-to-human transmission of the virus had taken place.
The virus, known also as 2019-nCoV, is understood to be a new strain of coronavirus that has not previously been identified in humans. The Sars virus that killed nearly 800 people globally in the early 2000s was also a coronavirus.
Signs of infection with the new virus include respiratory symptoms, fever, cough, shortness of breath and breathing difficulties.
The first US case was confirmed on Tuesday. President Donald Trump said the situation was "totally under control" and that he trusted the information being provided by Chinese authorities.
What is the latest on the outbreak?
Mr Li said there was evidence that the disease was "mainly transmitted through the respiratory tract". In general, coughs and sneezes are a highly effective way for viruses to spread.
But China has still not been able to confirm the exact source of the virus.
"Though the transmission route of the virus is yet to be fully understood, there is a possibility of virus mutation and a risk of further spread of the epidemic," said Mr Li.
He added that there were 2,197 people who were known to have come into contact with infected patients.
No "super spreader" - a patient who has transmitted the virus to more than 10 people - has been discovered so far.
At least 15 medical workers in Wuhan, who presumably came into contact with patients, are known to be infected.
Wuhan: Heart of the outbreak
It's not a Chinese mega-city as well known as Beijing or Shanghai, but Wuhan has connections with every part of the globe. Only slightly smaller than London, the city is home to an international airport that handles tens of millions of passengers each year.
These global links explain why the cases of the virus abroad have all involved people either from Wuhan or who had recently visited it.
The city has economic clout too - nearly half of the world's 500 biggest companies have invested there.
How fast is the virus spreading?
There's no way to know but it's likely to be exacerbated by the millions of people across China who are travelling within the country for the Lunar New Year week-long holiday. Thousands are also travelling abroad.
Mr Li added that the festival would "increase the risk of the disease spreading and the difficulty of prevention and control".
He said strict measures to control the disease would be put in place, calling for those in Wuhan to "avoid crowds and minimise public gatherings".
These measures include temperature screening for all those leaving Wuhan, and improved sterilisation and ventilation at major transport hubs.
A ban on the trade of live poultry and wild animals has also been implemented in the city. State media reports said police were conducting spot checks to make sure this was enforced.
The disease may have originally been passed from an animal to a human, said Gao Fu, director of the Chinese Centre for Disease Control and Prevention.
Where else have cases been reported?
There have been a handful of global cases: three cases in Thailand, one in Korea, one in Japan, one in Taiwan and one in the US.
On Wednesday, the city of Macau also reported its first confirmed case of the virus. The patient is said to be a businesswoman who arrived from Wuhan over the weekend.
Authorities in many places, including Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the US, Russia and Japan have stepped up screening of air passengers from Wuhan.
The UK is expected to begin screening passengers arriving at London's Heathrow airport from Wuhan.
In Australia, a man who had travelled to Wuhan has been placed in isolation and is undergoing tests.
Are the numbers accurate?
Experts say there could be many cases going undetected and they expect the official numbers to rapidly increase.
Researchers from the MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis at Imperial College London now estimate that there have probably been about 4,000 cases in Wuhan.
The centre's director, Prof Neil Ferguson, however said that the Chinese authorities had been "remarkably open" amid an "enormously demanding situation".
How the virus has spread
- 31 December: China alerts the WHO about a spate of pneumonia-like cases in Wuhan
- 1 January: The seafood/animal market believed to be at the centre of the outbreak is closed
- 9 January: WHO says the infection is caused by a new type of coronavirus
- 11 January: First death confirmed
- 13 January: Virus spreads abroad, with a suspected case in Thailand
- 16 January: A case in Japan is confirmed
- 17 January: Second death - a 69-year-old in Wuhan
- 20 January: Number of cases triples to more than 200, and outbreak spreads to Beijing, Shenzhen and Shanghai; third death confirmed; Chinese officials confirm human-to-human transmission
- 21 January: US authorities announce the first case in North America - a man who had visited Wuhan
- 22 January: Death toll climbs to 17, with more than 400 cases confirmed

title: Kali noolaanshuhu ma qaab nololeed cusub oo la higsanayaa "annagu ma nihin cidlo"
text:
Kali noolaanshuhu ma qaab nololeed cusub oo la higsanayaa "annagu ma nihin cidlo"
Waa habeen Jimce ah. Gabar dhallinyaro ah ayaa, iyadoo daallan, dib ugu soo laabanaysa gurigeeda ka dib maalin shaqo. Waxay gashaa jikada oo si fiican loo nadiifiyey, waxay dejisaa bacdii raashinka, ka dibna waxay furtaa baakad biisa la qaboojiyey oo ay gelisaa foornada.
Inta xigta waa hawl-maalmeed habeenle ah oo deggan, kana dhow ka-fiirsasho sababta oo ah sida uu u caadi u yahay: waxay shiddaa shumac, daqiiqad yar ayay ka eegtaa daaqadda muuqaalka bannaanka ee barafku daboolay, waxay saxan ku riddaa salad hore loo diyaariyey oo ay la cunto biisada, dabadeedna waxay ku fariisataa fadhiga iyadoo cashadeeda ku cunaysa horta telefishanka.
Qoraalka la socda muuqaalka wuxuu leeyahay: "Aragtidaada (POV): waxaad tahay gabar aan carruur lahayn, aan lammaane lahayn, aan saaxiibbo lahayn, isla markaana kaligeed ku nool, sidaas darteed sidan ayaad u qaadataa habeenka Jimcaha."
Bartamaha muuqaalkaas oo TikTok laga daawaday in ka badan toddoba milyan oo jeer waxaa ku jirta Lana Isa, oo ah maamule iibka software-ka ah, kana tirsan dadka da'doodu ku jirto labaatameeyada, kuna nool magaalada Toronto.
Marka laga soo tago inay la wadaagto habeen kasta daryeelka ay nafteeda u samayso, waxay ku hoggaamisaa ku dhowaad 400,000 oo qof oo ku xiran TikTok iyo Instagram safarro ay habeenkii ugu baxdo inay cunto degdeg ah soo iibsato, waqtiyo ay buugaag ku akhrido iyadoo ku fadhida dhagax ku yaal hareeraha haro, iyo xitaa sheekadii ay habeen dhexe bannaanka uga xannibantay gurigeeda ka dib markii ay furihii weyday.
Isa waxay ka tirsan tahay qayb sii kordhaysa, inkastoo ay weli yar tahay, oo ka mid ah bulshada internetka, halkaas oo abuureyaal badan oo nuxur sameeyabadankoodna haween yihiin ay la wadaagaan nolol-maalmeedkooda iyagoo kaligood nool. Waxay iftiiminayaan hab-nololeed mudnaanta siinaya xasilloonida iyo kalinimada, taas oo si weyn uga duwan buuqa iyo xad-dhaafka inta badan lagu arko baraha bulshada.
Isa waxay sheegtay in muujinta qaybta ah inay "aanay lahayn saaxiibbo" aysan u ahayn hal-ku-dheg lagu soo jiito dareenka dadka, balse ay ahayd xaqiiqada ay ku noolayd dhowr sano.
Kali ayaan ahay, laakiin cidlo ma dareemayo
Ka dib markii ay beddeshay dhowr dugsi sare, ay la kulantay go'doonkii xilligii cudurka Covid-19 intii ay jaamacadda dhiganaysay, isla markaana ay u guurtay dhinaca kale ee dalka ka dib jabkii jacaylkeedii ugu horreeyay, Isa waxay ku qasbanaatay inay la qabsato nolol ay kaligeed ku nooshahay iyadoo aan lahayn saaxiibbo dhow.
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
"Dadku si badan ugama hadlaan inay saaxiibbo la' yihiin... Waxaan u malaynayaa in weli loo arko arrin laga xishoodo ama wax laga aamuso," ayay tiri.
Markii ay bilowday inay baraha bulshada kula wadaagto waayo-aragnimadeeda ku saabsan saaxiibbo la'aanta, dad badan ayaa la falgalay oo dareenkooda la wadaagay. Tiradii dadka ku xirnayd TikTok, oo markii hore ahayd qiyaastii 2,000, waxay siddeed bilood gudahood kor ugu kacday in ka badan 175,000 oo qof.
"Waxay ii ahayd arrin indhaha ii furtay inaan arko dad kale oo ku nool xaalad la mid ah tii aan ku jiray... waxayna i siisay dareen ah inaan markii ugu horreysay muddo dheer ka dib la xiriiri karo oo aan wax la wadaagi karo dad kale."
Dadkuna runtii way la falgaleen. Qaybta faallooyinka ee Isa waxaa buuxiyey dad ka sheekaynaya waayo-aragnimooyin la mid ah oo ku saabsan inay kaligood noolaayeen ama aanay lahayn saaxiibbo, iyagoo sheegay inay ku heleen raaxo iyo dejanaan inay dareemeen "in la arkay oo la fahmay."
Sida ay inta badan u dhacdo isbeddellada ka dhasha internetka, xiisihii hore si dhaqso ah ayuu isu beddelay dhaleeceyn. Isa iyo hal-abuurayaal kale oo la mid ah waxaa lagu naanaysay "saameeyayaasha kelinimada" ), iyadoo qaar ay ku tilmaameen inay metelaan koox cusub oo ka kooban haween murugo leh, kaligood ah, aan carruur lahayn, isla markaana wajahaya dhibaato nololeed.
Dad kale ayaa ku eedeeyay inay qurxinayaan ama soo jiidasho u yeelayaan go'doominta nafta, isla markaana ay dhiirrigelinayaan "jawi guul-darro deggan oo lagu qanacsan yahay iyagoo ka fogaada samaynta iyo ilaalinta xiriirrada bulsho.
Laakiin muuqaalladooda gaagaaban waxay sawirayaan hab-nololeed ay dad badan si fudud ula xiriiri karaan, inkastoo qaar aysan jeclayn inay taas qirtaan. Haweenkan waxay kaligood isu kaxeeyaan ballamo ay naftooda ugu raaxaynayaan, waxay si kedis ah ugu baxaan safarro waddooyin dhaadheer ah, waxayna xitaa ka gudbaan xishoodka iyo raaxo-darrada ka dhalata inay kaligood ka qayb galaan xafladaha.
"Jebinta fikirka ah in kelinimadu tahay wax laga xishoodo."
Devon Noehring, oo sameeyso sheekooyin si waqti buuxda ah kana soo jeeda Phoenix, Arizona, isla markaana isku tilmaanta qof jecel kelinimada , waxay u aragtaa "wax niyad jab leh" in maalmaha fasaxa ah ee ay keligeed ku qaadato karinta iyo nasashada guriga iyada oo la joogta eeygeeda loo fasiray inay yihiin calaamad muujinaysa kalinimada haweenka.
"Taasi waa si buuxda lidka u ah ujeeddada fiidiyowyadeenna," ayay tiri. "Waxaan necbahay fikradda ah in qof keligiis jooga loola mid dhigo qof cidlo ah."
Inkasta oo Noehring, ay leedahay koox saaxiibo dhow ah, markii ay koraysay waxay mar walba dareemi jirtay "xishood" ku saabsan inay ahayd gabadh deggan oo la tacaalaysa welwelka bulshada. Ma ahayn ilaa ay internetka ku qiratay kalsooni darradeeda in ay ogaatay taageerayaal badan oo ah dad kale oo jecel kelinimada kuwaas oo la xiriiray caqabadaha ay la kulantay.
"Inaad keliday ahaato waa meesha aan ugu dareemo xorriyadda ugu badan, waana meesha aan si dhab ah naftayda ugu noqdo," ayay tiri. "Sidaas ayaan tamartayda dib ugu soo ceshadaa, waxaanan aad ugu faanaa inaan ahay qof isku filan oo aan waxyaabo kaligay sameyn karo… Waxaan u maleynayaa inay tahay wax mudan in la dabaaldego."
Qaar ka mid ah cilmi-baarayaasha caafimaadka ayaa ka shaqeynayay sidii loo "yareyn lahaa ceebta ku xeeran kalinimada" iyaga oo kala saaraya kalinimada daba-dheeraatay ee ay duruufuhu ku khasbaan qofka iyo dadka leh awoodda ay ku dooran karaan inay keligood noolaadaan ama waqti ku qaataan kelinimo.
"Qof walba mar uun ayuu dareemaa kalinimo, laakiin dadka qaarkood ma jecla inay qirtaan taas," ayay tiri Professor Melody Ding, oo ah cilmi-baare ku takhasusay cudurrada faafa (epidemiologist) kana baara xiriirka bulshada iyo kalinimada ee Jaamacadda Sydney. "Taasi waxay abuuri kartaa filasho khaldan oo ah in qofku mar walba ay tahay inuu ahaado mid bulsho ahaan faraxsan oo xiriirro badan leh."
"Waxaan doonaynaa inaan helno dad si an u xiriirno"
Xitaa marka ay mararka qaar dareemaan kalinimo, haweenkan waxay sheegayaan in kalinimadu aysan qeexin noloshooda, mana doonayaan inay si joogto ah u ahaadaan kuwo aan saaxiibo lahayn.
"Marna iskuma tilmaanno dad cidlo ah," ayay tiri SJ Hoadley, oo ka shaqeysa nadaafadda gudaha Boqortooyada Midowday (UK), isla markaana bilowday inay diiwaangeliso nolosheeda keligeed kadib markii ay daawatay fiidiyowyada Isa. "Waxaan u maleynayaa in mararka qaar saaxiibo la'aantaydu ay dadka igu hareeraysan uga dhib badan tahay sida ay aniga ii dhibayso."
Kadib markii ay ka tagtay xiriir xadgudub ahaa oo socday toddobo sano, waxay u guurtay meel cusub oo aysan cidna ka aqoon, waxaana ay la kulantay caqabad ah inay dib u dhisto nolosheeda. Inkasta oo markii hore ay la kulantay "naxdin," ugu dambayn waxay bilowday inay "ku raaxaysato oo ay soo dhoweyso madax-bannaanidaas" isla markaana "ay ku qanacdo oo ay ku raaxaysato la joogitaanka nafteeda."
Dr Anne Oeldorf-Hirsch oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Connecticut, oo ku takhasustay sida aadanuhu bulsho uga sameystaan internetka, waxay sheegaysaa in nidaamka baraha bulshada ee si joogto ah nagu soo bandhiga nolol hammi leh iyo xaalad joogto ah oo ah FOMO (cabsida ah inaad wax ka maqnaato), kororka dadka saamaynta ku leh baraha bulshada ee ku nool nolol kelinimo ah uu dhiirrigelin u noqon karo kuwa isku arka qaab nololeedkaas.
"Waxaa jiray muddo dheer falcelin ka dhan ah fikradda ah in aan aragno nolosha qumman ee qof walba, qaybaha ugu quruxda badan oo keliya ee noloshooda," ayay tiri.
Oeldorf-Hirsch waxay aaminsan tahay in waxyaabaha ku saabsan kelinimada ay buuxinayaan baahi bulsho oo ay qabaan abuurayaasha nuxurkaas iyo dadka daawada, iyagoo siinaya "dheelitirnaan" ka dhan ah dhaqanka saameeyayaasha (influencers) ee aadka loo qurxiyey oo la buunbuuniyey.
"Waxaan u muuqannaa inaan u sii jeedno saameeyayaal ka run badan, oo ku nool noloshooda dhabta ah," ayay tiri. "Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno dad aan isku aragno oo aan isku fahamno."
Hoadley waxay aragtay tirada dadka raacsan oo mararka qaar kor u kacda tobannaan kun maalintii, halka fiidiyowyada Noehring ay malaayiin daawasho ka heleen kanaalladeeda kala duwan.
Xiriirradaas internetka ayaa Hoadley ku abuuray farxad ku aaddan mustaqbal ay ku heli karto "koox yar oo saaxiibo dumar ah." Noehring waxay rajaynaysaa in maalin uun ay qabanqaabiso kulan dhab ah oo ay la yeelato bulshadeeda internetka, halka Isa ay sheegtay in taageerada ay heshay ay siisay "dhiirrigelintii" ay u baahnayd si ay mar kale uga fikirto samaysashada saaxiibo.
"Waxaan u maleynayaa in dhammaan nuxurkaasi uu leeyahay fariintan: hel jidkaaga," ayay tiri Hoadley. "Ma aha inay noqoto hal qaab oo qof walba lagu qasbo, sida waxa baraha bulshada mar walba nalagu riixo."

title: Hotunan ziyarar Anthony Blinken a Najeriya
text:
Nan gaba a yau Juma'a ne ake sa ran Sakataren Harkoki Wajen Amurka, Anthony Blinken zai yi bayani sosai a kan dangantakar Amurka da Afrika a karkashin shugabancin Joe Biden a yayin da yake ci gaba da ziyara a Najeriya.
Mista Blinken ya gana da Shugaba Muhammadu Buhari, Mataimakin Shugaba Buhari wato Farfesa Yemi Osinbajo da Ministan Harkokin Wajen Najeriya, Geoffrey Onyeama a fadar Aso Rock da ke Abuja ranar Alhamis.
Ziyarar tasa, wadda ita ce ta farko a Afrika, ya somo ta ne daga Kenya.
A ganawarsa da Shugaba Buhari, Mista Blinken ya ce ya kamata a hukunta jami'an tsaron da ake zargi da kisan masu zanga-zangar Endsars a shekarar da ta wuce.
Ga karin hotunan da Mista Blinken ya dauka da manyan jami'an gwamnatin Najeriya

title: World Athletics Championships 2025 results: Noah Lyles wins fourth 200m gold
text:
'Energised' Lyles makes happier Tokyo memories after heartbreak
- Published
There is more to Noah Lyles than just the showmanship, the grandstanding and the dyed orange hair.
The irrepressible American held off a stellar field in the 200m final at the World Athletics Championships in Tokyo on Friday to win his fourth successive world title in the discipline.
It forms a stark contrast to his Olympic results in the discipline â bronze in Tokyo in 2021, the same last year in Paris amid struggles with Covid.
But back in the Japanese capital, Lyles banished the painful memories Tokyo previously held to equal Usain Bolt's title record.
"I can't wait for 2027 to become the only man to win five 200 metres titles," said Lyles.
"I don't have good memories from Tokyo in 2021. At that time I was depressed, but this time I am energised. I love what I do and I am happy.
"My face is blasted everywhere over Tokyo. This is a joyous moment I am going to keep with me forever."
Lyles, dethroned as world 100m champion on Sunday as he took bronze, captured gold in his favoured discipline five days later to secure his eighth global title.
He had produced a statement performance in Thursday's semi-finals, setting the fastest time of 2025 in 19.51 seconds.
After a final where he was just 0.01 seconds slower, he celebrated by raising four fingers to the crowd.
It was at the World Championships two years ago that Lyles asserted himself as the dominant male sprinter on the sport's biggest stages with three golds in Budapest, before claiming the Olympic 100m title at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
Prior to the championships, Lyles told reporters that he would take bronze in the 100m if it meant he would get 200m gold by breaking Bolt's world-record time.
He got the gold - but Bolt's record remains elusive for now.
Lyles' American team-mate Kenny Bednarek had to settle for silver â his fourth in a row across the last four Olympic and world championships.
Bednarek and Lyles have a tempestuous relationship, and almost came to blows at the US trials when Lyles stared down his opponent in beating him to the 200m title, to which Bednarek responded with a shove.
Bronze went to 21-year-old Jamaican Bryan Levell, with Olympic champion Letsile Tebogo fourth. Britain's Zharnel Hughes ran a season-best 19.78 for fifth.
Bol celebrates gold - and her upcoming wedding
With Olympic women's 400m hurdles champion Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone opting to focus â with remarkable success â on the flat event, Femke Bol lived up to her favourite tag to retain her world title.
The Dutchwoman won in 51.54 seconds, while American Jasmine Jones took silver in a personal best of 52.03. Emma Zapletalova set a Slovakian national record of 53.00 to claim bronze.
Bol said taking a break after the Paris Olympics had helped her prepare for her successful season â as did planning her wedding.
She announced her engagement to Belgian pole vaulter Ben Broeders in July and said their upcoming nuptials were "a great distraction".
"As a track and field athlete you work really hard, but you also have a lot of time to rest, and it's also a nice thing to think about," she said.
Bol did, however, admit she could have competed against McLaughlin-Levrone, who beat her into third place on the way to gold in Paris.
"I most likely wouldn't be here with the gold medal but I really love to race her," said the 25-year-old of McLaughlin-Levrone.
"She's the best athlete to ever do it in my event so I would have loved to do it, but I also love to see her do so well in the 400 metres."
'Who's the best?' - Triple jump reaches incredible conclusion
Arguably the most dramatic event of Friday was the men's triple jump, in which Portugal's Pedro Pichardo emulated the gold he won at the Tokyo Olympics in phenomenal style.
Pichardo led going into the final jumps with a distance of 17.55 metres â but this was spectacularly overtaken by Italy's Andrea Dallavalle.
Dallavalle, only fifth in the standings up to that point, leaped a massive personal best of 17.64m to take the lead.
With the women's 200m final delayed to allow the triple jump to conclude and the whole arena watching, Pichardo then jumped 17.91 metres with his final effort - the best of anyone this year.
"Who's the best?" he roared down the camera in celebration. There could be no argument.
Cuba's Lazaro Martinez, who pulled up with a muscle injury during his run up for his final jump, took bronze.

title: Wizz Air: Cardiff Airport in wrong place, says ex-airline boss
text:
Cardiff Airport was built in the wrong place to attract passengers, the former boss of a low-cost airline has said.
David Bryon, ex-director of BMI Baby, which operated from the airport between 2002-2011, said no-one in their "right mind" would invest in the airport.
He spoke after budget airline Wizz Air announced it was quitting Cardiff and data showed passenger numbers had fallen following the Covid pandemic.
The Welsh government said smaller UK airports were vital to the economy.
"Nobody in their right mind would look at investing in the airport as an infrastructure," said Mr Bryon.
"It's not an attractive proposition as an airport for an investor."
Annual passengers numbers have fallen since the pandemic, down from 1.6 million in 2019 to 812,000 in the year to November 2022, external.
Meanwhile, Doncaster Sheffield Airport, which ceased operations due to "financial viability" last month, had 1.4 million passengers in 2019, according to data, external from the Civil Aviation Authority.
"What I think was most alarming is, we saw an airport actually shut down with similar levels to Cardiff," Mr Bryon said.
"Doncaster was carrying similar pre-pandemic passenger levels of 1.5 million... and sadly they announced in September that it's closing.
"If you can't get above two, three, four million [passengers] then... it's very difficult for it to break even, let alone make money, and we saw that with Doncaster."
Cardiff Airport was valued at Â£15m in 2021, but the Welsh government bought it for Â£52m in 2013.
Mr Bryon told BBC Radio Wales Drive BMI Baby had considered Cardiff a "key attraction" when it started routes in 2002 as it thought it could grow the market.
He claimed its coastal location at Rhoose, Vale of Glamorgan, meant it could not attract as many passengers as other airports that were totally surrounded by potential customers.
"There just isn't the volume [of passengers]. Not only is Cardiff Airport on the coast, which limits its catchment, it's on the wrong side of Cardiff," he explained.
To make the airport work, Mr Bryon said it would have to attract customers from England, but its position a 25-minute drive "down a country road to actually get to the airport" once customers left the M4 made it "quite a bind" to get to.
"Its location, unfortunately, is all wrong," he said, adding: "Losing Wizz Air is a huge blow to the airport."
"You look at Bristol, which is somewhere in the region of eight or nine million, and then we go up to 14 million for Birmingham... you've got to really get to that four to five million [passengers] to be able to make the airport viable.
"If we look at Monday, there are seven flights taking off, and seven landing back at Cardiff."
What's the history of Cardiff Airport?
- Cardiff Airport's present site dates back to the 1940s when the Air Ministry requisitioned land for a war-time aerodrome and training base for RAF pilots
- In 1965, control of the airport was transferred to the former Glamorgan County Council and successor authorities in the 1970s
- First transatlantic flight in 1971 followed by runway extensions allowing 747 jumbo jets to land and take-off
- The airport was privatised in 1995 but in 2013 it was purchased by the Welsh government
Source: cardiff-airport.com, external
Jane Dodds, the leader of the Welsh Liberal Democrats, said the Welsh government had serious questions to answer about the airport's future.
"With a bill of Â£210m since the Welsh government purchased the airport and no sign of things improving, taxpayers will rightly be asking what value for money they are getting," she said.
"Imagine what Â£210m of taxpayers' money could have done if it had been ploughed into sustainable transport in Wales instead."
The Welsh government did not specifically address the concerns over the airport's location or its future, but said: "Our Covid recovery plan remains in place, but clearly the current economic climate is incredibly tough for the aviation sector.
"Smaller airports are vital to regional economies across the UK and we urge the UK government to provide the support to put them on a secure footing for the future."
The UK government said the management and location of Cardiff Airport was a devolved matter for the Welsh government.

title: Charlie Kirk: How a teenage activist became such a close Trump ally
text:
How a college dropout from the suburbs became Maga star Charlie Kirk
One of the first people JD Vance called before deciding to jump into politics was Charlie Kirk.
"[Kirk] introduced me to some of the people who would run my [Senate] campaign and also to Donald Trump Jr," the vice-president wrote in a powerful tribute he penned hours after Kirk's death.
"Don took a call from me because Charlie asked him."
Three years after that winning Senate run, when the elder Donald Trump was pondering his choice of presidential running mate, Kirk argued the case for Vance "in public and private", Vance wrote.
By then, Kirk was already a fixture in Trump's orbit, courting donors and discussing strategies at Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida and hosting Turning Point USA summits hosted by local Republicans.
He never ran for office or held an official government position, but Kirk rose from being an unknown activist from the suburbs of Chicago to standard bearer of Donald Trump's Maga movement.
Kirk was President Trump's bridge to young Republicans, and Trump credited him and his organisation with his victory in 2024.
He was also a close personal friend of the Trump family, a key White House adviser, a hero to many young Republicans and a foil for the party's opponents.
A meteoric rise to MAGA star
Born in a suburb of Chicago in 1993, Kirk got started early in conservative politics, first penning an essay for right-wing Breitbart News at the age of 18, accusing schools of spreading "propaganda" and "indoctrination".
He caught the eye of Bill Montgomery, a retired businessman and Tea Party activist more than 50 years his senior, who took Kirk under his wing.
In 2012 – around the midpoint of Barack Obama's presidency – the pair founded Turning Point USA (TPUSA), a group which focused on conservative activism on college campuses, spreading rapidly along with Kirk's social media following.
The group tapped into online media and spread a slickly packaged style of conservatism to young people. It won him a speaking place, aged 22, at the 2016 Republican National Convention.
At the time, Kirk - who had worked with more conventional Republican candidates in the past - admitted to a Wired magazine that he "was not the world's biggest Donald Trump fan".
But from that moment on he quickly became one of Trump's biggest backers, steadfastly tracking the Maga agenda and disagreeing only on rare occasions.
Following Kirk's death, Jared Kushner - the president's son in-law - wrote on X that he "played a significant role in helping President Trump's 2016 campaign, building and fostering the Maga movement", adding that he told established political organisations that "he comes with big ideas, is easy to work with and always overdelivers."
Lawrence Muir, a former official in Trump's first administration, said that Kirk's influence was key early on in Trump's first term, and that TPUSA "was the main recruitment vehicle for younger people."
But perhaps his more far-reaching impact, Mr Muir said, was in giving other conservatives an understanding of social media and how to reach young people.
"What [Kirk] really did was give a launching pad to those who weren't as interested in becoming bureaucratic functionaries, but were in going out and building winning coalitions," he said.
Hard-right Trump loyalist
Kirk's political views drifted rightward over time. He was against gay marriage and abortion, argued for Christian nationalism and was highly critical of Islam, and famously said that gun deaths were "worth it" for the right to own firearms. He was also an opponent of diversity programmes and spread falsehoods about topics such as Covid vaccines and voting fraud.
Above all, he was loyal to Trump.
At the end of Trump's first term, with the president pushing false allegations of election fraud, Kirk bragged about sending 80 buses of supporters to Washington just in time for the rally which devolved into the Jan 6 riot at the US Capitol.
Kirk was hauled in front of a Congressional committee investigating the riot and declined to say much of anything, instead invoking his constitutional right not to incriminate himself.
But by July 2024 he had tempered his views, telling the BBC that he believed it existed but only "on the edges". Instead, he said and his group were laser focused - like the Trump campaign - on maximising early voting methods that they had previously shunned as illegitimate and ripe for fraud.
Credit from Trump
Kirk poured millions of TPUSA dollars and thousands of volunteers into get-out-the-vote efforts in swing states during last year's election, and his strategy appears to have worked.
The organisation's "ground game" was crucial, analysts say, helping make up for the formal Trump campaign's struggles reaching infrequent voters, or those untouched by traditional outreach.
Although Democrat Kamala Harris won the youth vote overall, it was by a far smaller margin than that of Joe Biden's 2020 victory.
Trump himself gave Kirk credit at TPUSA's annual AmericaFest conference in December, just a few weeks after his election victory.
"I want to express my tremendous gratitude to Charlie Kirk. He's really an amazing guy, amazing guy and his whole staff for their relentless efforts to achieve this very historic victory," Trump said.
The gathering was triumphant, bombastic and slickly produced, with huge video screens - a demonstration of TPUSA's deep pockets. The group has now spread to 3,500 high schools and colleges and brought in more than $85m (£62m) last year, according to investigative journalism outlet ProPublica.
It also showed off Kirk's ability to bring together disparate wings of the Make America Great Again movement - members of Congress, dark arts strategists like Roger Stone and conspiracy-obsessed social media influencers.
Ever closer to White House power
Kirk's influence arguably grew even more during Trump's second term. Just two days before Trump took office, the pair played golf together in Mar-a-Lago.
His relationships with Trump and the rest of the family even gave him sway over government posts - Kirk was reportedly involved in vetting administration appointees earlier this year.
In his tribute, Vance wrote: "He didn't just help us win in 2024, he helped us staff the entire government."
And while his social media and podcast output continued at pace, along with campus tours and other speaking commitments, he continued to hew to Trump's agenda.
After criticising the Justice Department for dragging its feet on releasing files related to the sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, he took a phone call with Trump. Shortly thereafter, Kirk declared that he was "done talking about Epstein".
News of his killing hit the White House hard, starting with the startled gasps of young staffers who saw news of the shooting while scrolling on their phones.
"Oh my God," one young woman was heard saying, before scurrying down a hallway to tell others. "Charlie Kirk has been shot!"
Some staff were wiping away tears. President Trump received updates and fielded phone calls from the Oval Office before ultimately taking to Truth Social to publicly confirm his death and later delivering a video address on his murder and ordering flags across the country to fly at half-staff.
"Charlie was very much a part of this family, and maybe the highest-profile Maga person outside of those that are working here," Chief-of-Staff Susie Wiles told CNN. "I think it shook everybody to their core."
Donald Trump Jr posted his own message saying that Kirk "wasn't just a friend, he was like a little brother to me.
Dr Matthew Dallek, a professor at George Washington University and expert on modern conservatism, said that the close personal ties between Kirk and the Trump family were "really important" to the TPUSA founder's broader influence.
"Trump prizes loyalty, above maybe anything else," he said. "And if Don Jr is saying he was like a brother to him, that suggests just how great a supporter Kirk was. They viewed him as an absolutely critical ally and advisor.
"There was a kindred spirit there, and they did not have to worry about him bolting from the movement. He was loyal."

title: HMS Prince of Wales to get freedom of city on Liverpool return
text:
HMS Prince of Wales to get freedom of city honour
A Royal Navy aircraft carrier is set to receive an illustrious civic honour, as it returns to its affiliated city for the first time in four years.
HMS Prince of Wales will be given a freedom of the city award as it arrives into Liverpool for a week on 2 December.
It will be the first time in four years the ship has visited the city.
The Royal Navy's largest ship will dock on the River Mersey at the Cruise Liner Terminal to give visitors an insight into life on board the Portsmouth-based vessel.
Some 800 of its crew will also visit local schools, community projects and civic leaders while it is docked.
HMS Prince of Wales was last in Liverpool in March 2020, just before the country went into lockdown at the beginning of the coronavirus pandemic.
About 20,000 people came to visit the ship in 2020, and commanding officer, captain Will Blackett is hoping for a similar welcome on its return.
He said: "It is a great privilege to bring the ship to Liverpool – a city with very special historical links to the Royal Navy – and it is a particular honour for us to receive the Freedom of the City.
"The ship’s company deserve recognition for their remarkable efforts, and this visit allows us to show you what we do."
'Our gorgeous city'
Among the crew is sub lieutenant Yasemin Dilek, who comes from Liverpool.
She said the ship was a "home away from home" with reminders on board such as passageway signs titled, Smithdown Road, Matthew Street and Anfield.
“I believe we take a part of Liverpool everywhere we go," she said.
"I’m certain the first sight of those two Liver birds, set against our gorgeous city skyline, as we bring the ship through the River Mersey to our berth, will be a highlight which I will cherish for the rest of my career."
A freedom parade will take place on 6 December and will be the first time the sailors will have had the opportunity to celebrate being given the city’s highest civic honour.
A main passageway on the ship will also be renamed after the Beatles classic, Penny Lane, complete with a street sign donated on behalf of the city, by Lord Mayor, councillor Richard Kemp.
A ceremonial sunset demonstration supported by the Corps of Drums of His Majesty’s Royal Marines will take place during the week.
Thousands of guests are also expected to visit the ship when it opens its gangway to the public for a ticketed event on 7 and 8 December.

title: Spurs sponsorship deal criticised by South Africans
text:
South Africa's official tourism board says it intends to continue to pursue a proposed sponsorship deal with Premier League side Tottenham Hotspur, despite public uproar after details were leaked in the media this week.
Themba Khumalo, the acting CEO of South African Tourism (SAT), said while there was no signed contract as yet, the board had conditionally approved the proposed three-year deal worth 900m South African rand (Â£42.5m/$52.5m).
Khumalo revealed that despite details of the deal - proposed to start at the beginning of the 2023-24 Premier League season - being leaked, confidentiality agreements mean he is unable to confirm the finer points.
âSomebody maliciously leaked confidential documentation into the press - prematurely - while the discussion was still being had,â Khumalo said.
The board of SAT, which sits under the auspices of the South African government, conditionally approved the deal after travelling to London in January, Khumalo explained.
He added that the various government stakeholders had yet to be contacted, as had been intended by now, given that SAT is having to deal with the fallout of the leak.
âWe are part of a broader tourism family, and we cannot simply proceed regardless of what our stakeholders are saying.
"We've got to be sensitive to what our partners are saying and make sure that everybody is on board, then we can move together holistically. So that is where the deal is right now.â

'Misguided vanity project'
The proposed deal with a team lying fifth in the Premier League has come under criticism from different quarters in South Africa, which is undergoing economic challenges at present.
Some believe the money intended to fund the proposed sponsorship could be better utilised in a country battling daily power blackouts, water shortages and significant unemployment.
Several national sports federations have also added their voice to the criticism, saying the money could help fund financially-challenged national bodies and local athletes.
The Congress of South Africa Trade Unions (Cosatu), the countryâs biggest trade union federation, labelled the proposed deal as an insult to struggling workers and taxpayers.
